description:
Deployment-tunable knobs of ``dataset/split`` (ADR-0070) — the split ratios
+ seed. **Operational** scope (the default): a workflow/run may tune these
freely. A subset of ``SplitInput``; the safe defaults live on ``SplitInput``.

train_ratio.description: Fraction of rows/groups assigned to train.
train_ratio.title: Train ratio

val_ratio.description: Fraction of rows/groups assigned to val.
val_ratio.title: Val ratio

test_ratio.description: Fraction assigned to test (0 omits test.jsonl).
test_ratio.title: Test ratio

seed.description: Seed for the deterministic hash/shuffle assignment (reproducible split).
seed.title: Split seed

shard_size.description: Rows per output shard (#891); 0 writes one file per split (default).
shard_size.title: Output shard size

title: SplitConfig
